(() => { const n = document.querySelector('[data-mail-name]'); n.value = 'Zoë 名前'; n.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); const t = document.querySelector('[data-mail-text]'); t.value = 'Preview test: ça marche? こんにちは 🚀'; t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); return 'count: ' + document.querySelector('[data-mail-count]').textContent + ', send enabled: ' + !document.querySelector('[data-mail-send]').disabled; })()

(() => { const t = document.querySelector('[data-mail-text]'); t.value = 'x'.repeat(600); t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); return 'over the limit: ' + document.querySelector('[data-mail-count]').textContent + ', kept ' + [...t.value].length; })()
